name: Leaf Blower Suction, All Maps
author: the loader's own repo
description: Makes the leaf blower's SUCTION mode available by default on every map except Sakura, where it stays behind its normal purchase. Built on the loader's method-detour capability: it overrides LeafBlowerBehaviour.get_CanToggleMode with a per-map decision computed off the game thread. Safe to delete; the loader hosts without it.
_modeNote: except-sakura = the requested behaviour: suction free on Hometown/Castle, still bought in Sakura. Needs the map signal below pinned (see MODLOG R9). Until it is pinned it stays vanilla. all-maps = suction on every map including Sakura; needs no map reverse-engineering and works today.
_mapSignalNote: The current map is read via MainContext.get_ActiveScene -> its get_name (both dispatchable on this build). The live probe confirmed get_name returns the map name exactly: Sakura / Castle / Hometown (and Menu plus transient menu objects at the title). sakuraScene is now pinned to Sakura, so except-sakura is LIVE: suction forced on in Castle/Hometown, still bought in Sakura.
